activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 7 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: You can report a fault to the person responsible for the building.
cards.explanation: Report a fault means inform the responsible person about a problem.

cards.statement: A power cut is a temporary loss of electricity.
cards.explanation: A power cut means the electricity supply stops temporarily.

cards.statement: A tenant owns every property they live in.
cards.explanation: A tenant rents and occupies a property; the landlord usually owns it.

cards.statement: A plumber repairs pipes and taps.
cards.explanation: Plumbers work with water pipes, taps and similar systems.

cards.statement: A wardrobe is normally used for washing dishes.
cards.explanation: A wardrobe stores clothes; a sink or dishwasher is used for dishes.

cards.statement: Repair and replace always mean exactly the same thing.
cards.explanation: Repair means fix an item; replace means remove it and put in another one.

cards.statement: Give notice can mean formally tell a landlord you will leave.
cards.explanation: Give notice is a formal expression used before leaving a rented property.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: A plumber is the most suitable professional for a dangerous fuse-box fault.
cards.explanation: An electrician should handle electrical faults; a plumber handles water systems.

cards.statement: A deposit is always the same thing as monthly rent.
cards.explanation: A deposit is security money, while rent is the regular payment for the property.

cards.statement: A sofa is a piece of furniture.
cards.explanation: A sofa is furniture used for sitting.

cards.statement: A bathroom is normally where people sleep.
cards.explanation: People normally sleep in a bedroom, not a bathroom.

cards.statement: Furniture is normally used as an uncountable noun.
cards.explanation: Say some furniture or a piece of furniture, not usually a furniture.

cards.statement: The sentence There is a furniture in the hall is standard English.
cards.explanation: Furniture is uncountable; say there is some furniture or a piece of furniture.

cards.statement: A leak is an unwanted flow of liquid.
cards.explanation: A leak is liquid escaping from a pipe, roof or container.

cards.statement: A kitchen is used for preparing food.
cards.explanation: A kitchen is the room where food is prepared and cooked.

activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: An electrician normally repairs blocked sinks.
cards.explanation: An electrician handles electricity; a plumber repairs sinks and pipes.

cards.statement: A balcony is usually outside a flat or house.
cards.explanation: A balcony is an outdoor platform attached to a building.

cards.statement: Rent is a regular payment for a rented home.
cards.explanation: Rent is paid in exchange for using a property.

cards.statement: A tenant is usually the person who owns and rents out the property.
cards.explanation: The owner who rents out the property is the landlord; the tenant rents it.

cards.statement: A boiler can provide hot water and heating.
cards.explanation: A boiler commonly heats water and supplies central heating.
